summary: Spec gained a judge field: evals.backbone._drive() now calls evals.rebuilt.grading.Judge.grade() while the subject is alive, mirroring evals/rebuilt/runner.run_once()'s own judge call, and carries the verdict through NORA_JUDGED for MeetsGrader to read -- the last missing piece for S3 (grounding) and S9 (injection) corpora, which need a judge's opinion, not just a structural signal.
details: Judged only when there is something to judge (outcome.said and no error) -- judging silence answers a question nobody asked and risks a false PASS on a case that should have been graded structurally.
Built once per Experiment batch (Judge's own docstring: built once per run, not per case), matching Spec's existing per-batch fields.

5 new tests (a real judge call's kwargs, verdict carried through, no judge configured is a no-op, silence is never judged), all mechanical (a fake Judge, no network). Falsified: disabling the judge call turned the calls-recorded test red before restoring it.
